message.content:
I've reproduced the crash. The heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 occurs in `g_utf8_casefold` at `guniprop.c:1170`, called from `g_date_fill_parse_tokens` at `gdate.c:1011`, which is called from `g_date_set_parse`.

The simplest triggering input is a single byte `\xfd` (invalid UTF-8). This is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1, exactly matching the issue description.

Let me look at the exact line in `g_utf8_casefold` (line 1170) to understand the root cause.
